description: This file contains the PHP class 'CustomField' which manages CRUD operations and data retrieval for custom fields in the Opencart admin module specific to the customer section.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Model class providing methods to manage custom fields including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving custom field data and associated descriptions, customer groups, and values.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field record in the database, including related descriptions, customer groups, and values. Returns the new custom field's ID.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field record and its related descriptions, customer groups, and values based on the provided data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specified custom field.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field and all its related descriptions, customer groups, and values from the database.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific custom field, including descriptions for the current language.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves a list of custom fields based on filtering options such as name, type, status, location, and customer group.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total count of custom fields matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description record for a custom field in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all description records for a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes description records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all description records for a custom field across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all description records for a specific language ID.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a customer group, optionally marking it as required.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes all customer group associations for a particular custom field.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all customer groups associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Inserts a new value for a custom field, along with its descriptions across languages.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all value records linked to a specific custom field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field value and its description for the current language.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Fetches all values for a given custom field, ordered by sort_order.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Creates a description for a custom field value in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions associated with a custom field.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all value descriptions for a custom field, organized by value ID and language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all value descriptions for a specific language.
